items.title: Alecto lands €18 million to scale its AI-powered law firm beyond property transactions
items.summary: Alecto, a British AI-native law firm, has raised a €18 million ($20 million) Seed round, to support the company’s expansion into additional areas of consumer law and new geographies, with its first international launch planned for 2027.
